sources.title: Data Efficient learning | AI Research Papers
sources.snippet: Data-efficient learning aims to develop AI/ML models that can achieve high performance with significantly less training data than traditional methods. This is crucial because acquiring and labeling large datasets can be expensive, time-consuming, or even infeasible in many real-world applications like medical diagnosis, robotics, and rare event detection.
